verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot ships built-in agent mode and cloud agents that let users assign tasks (e.g., 'fix this bug', 'implement this feature') for autonomous planning, exploration, and execution, with a control plane to track multiple agent sessions and merge completed work (github-copilot-docs-2,3,6,8,14,15,16). Community evidence largely reflects on completion quality/licensing debates rather than disputing the agent-delegation capability itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of the autonomous 'assign and let it work in background' workflow (most community evidence predates or doesn't test agent mode).
